glosses: to notch, to nick, to score

examples.text: ... wydobył z kieszeni nóż i naciął nim opuszki lewej ręki.
examples.translation: ... he got a knife out of his pocket and cut the fingertips of his left hand with it.
examples.english: ... he got a knife out of his pocket and cut the fingertips of his left hand with it.

examples.text: Potem wyjął nóż – i drugi znaczek naciął na swym kiju.
examples.translation: Then he took out a knife – and cut a second mark on his cane.
examples.english: Then he took out a knife – and cut a second mark on his cane.

glosses: to gather (a lot of something) by cutting

examples.text: Naciął kamienną siekierą mnóstwo młodych drzewek...
examples.translation: He cut down a lot of young trees with a stone axe...
examples.english: He cut down a lot of young trees with a stone axe...

examples.text: Z niego [drzewa] naciął Abraham gałęzi na stos...
examples.translation: Abraham cut a lot of branches from it [the tree] for a pyre...
examples.english: Abraham cut a lot of branches from it [the tree] for a pyre...

glosses: to cheat or defraud (someone) out of something, especially money

examples.text: W toku dochodzenia zdołano ustalić, że Grzegorz G. naciął na pieniądze 27 kobiet...
examples.translation: In the course of the investigation, they managed to determine that Grzegorz G. had cheated 27 women out of money...
examples.english: In the course of the investigation, they managed to determine that Grzegorz G. had cheated 27 women out of money...

glosses: to cut oneself, to nick oneself, to wound oneself
to unexpectedly meet, to run into

examples.text: Naciął się wprawdzie jeden i drugi na obecnego we wnętrzu któregoś z domków Niemca...
examples.translation: In truth, the one and the other ran into a German present in the interior of one of the houses...
examples.english: In truth, the one and the other ran into a German present in the interior of one of the houses...

glosses: to suffer losses by thinking something is more valuable than it is

examples.text: Resort chciał sprawdzić, czy tylko on naciął się na [niesprawne] kupowane w pośpiechu maseczki, które miały pomóc w walce z koronawirusem.
examples.translation: The resort wanted to check whether it was the only one that had been tricked into paying for [nonfunctional] hastily bought surgical masks which were supposed to help in the fight with the coronavirus.
examples.english: The resort wanted to check whether it was the only one that had been tricked into paying for [nonfunctional] hastily bought surgical masks which were supposed to help in the fight with the coronavirus.

glosses: ponieść straty w związku z mylnym uznaniem czegoś za lepsze, niż jest w rzeczywistości

examples.text: Niekiedy w sklepach możemy naciąć się na podrabiane trunki. Słono kosztują – podle smakują.
